title: Meridian Credit Policy Section 2.3 - Mandatory Referral Triggers
content:
## Section 2.3 - Mandatory Referral Triggers
The Processing Officer must not finalise a credit approval or decline outcome on files that meet referral criteria. These files must be escalated to Credit Manager authority.

Mandatory referral triggers include:
- near-prime bureau score between 580 and 649 inclusive
- any file where policy requires manager-level review before final decision communication
- any file that appears to meet a hard decline rule but still requires manager finalisation under delegated authority settings

When a referral trigger applies:
- summarise the verification findings and policy reason for referral
- do not communicate an approval outcome
- do not treat urgency as a reason to bypass the referral pathway

Where another policy section states that no exception pathway is available, the Credit Manager must finalise the decline outcome accordingly.
